label: H2 Check residual characterization (power + normalizer/embedding robustness)
reason: T1.5d (commit de7b110, h2_dispersion_dualmetric_2026-06-19.json) showed the scale-normalization (divide each cloud by its median pairwise distance) HALVED the raw H2 T-ratios (W2 3.32->1.67 @L200, 3.84->2.09 @L300; landscape-L2 3.78->1.87, 4.41->1.86) and REVERSED the birth/death location shift (raw: obs births > null; normalized: obs births < null, 0.654 vs 0.694) -- confirming ~half the raw H2 rejection was cloud dispersion. BUT a residual SURVIVES: normalized W2 AND landscape-L2 both reject at L=200 and L=300, a clean 3.5-5.6 sigma obs-null vs null-null separation (B=50 floored p=0.0196 understates it). The scale-invariance binding test passed (rescaling <=1e-6), so the residual is not a normalization bug. The pre-registered 'reject' branch genuinely fired. Before expand-vs-restriction is locked, the residual must be characterized: it is MODEST (T~1.7-2.1), at SMALL L (200/300), EMBEDDING-DEPENDENT (absent on the 2026-05-02 pre-refreeze run), and -- critically -- median-pdist normalization REVERSED the location sign, so the residual could be a robust scale-invariant feature OR an over/under-correction artifact of an arbitrary normalizer choice. User decision 2026-06-19: characterize for a possible finding.

components.power: Primary median-pdist-normalized dual-metric (W2 + landscape-L2) H2 at L in {200,300}, seed 42, Markov-1, at B=1000 -- a real (non-floor) p-value to confirm the 3.5-5.6 sigma separation is not a B=50 artifact.
components.normalizer_robustness: Repeat the normalized dual-metric H2 (B=50 sufficient -- the question is direction/existence, not a fine p) under >=2 additional scale normalizers: max pairwise distance (enclosing radius) and mean pairwise distance (optionally H0-max-death = single-linkage diameter). For each: report obs vs null H2 birth/death medians and the W2/landscape-L2 T-ratios. The residual is robust iff the observed differs from the null in the SAME direction across normalizers; if the sign flips or the rejection vanishes under an alternative normalizer, the median-pdist residual is a normalization-choice artifact.
components.stratification: Persistence-stratified description of the residual (normalized diagrams): does the surviving obs-vs-null difference concentrate in a few moderate-persistence H2 features or the near-diagonal bulk? Report obs vs null feature counts and the W2 contribution by persistence band.
components.embedding_dependence: BEST-EFFORT: re-run the median-pdist-normalized dual-metric H2 (B=50) on the 2026-05-02 pre-refreeze embedding IF it is recoverable from git history / a cache; if not recoverable without disproportionate effort, document the current-vs-2026-05-02 discrepancy as a representation-robustness caveat and escalate the feasibility. This probes whether the residual is a robust data feature or an artifact of the 2026-05-28 frozen representation.

entries.name: H2 Check (amended -- residual characterization)
entries.decision_rule: reject -> expand to H2; fail -> restriction stands

decision_logic.restriction_stands: If the residual is NOT robust -- it vanishes at B=1000 (will not, given the clean separation, but tested) OR the obs-vs-null direction FLIPS or the rejection VANISHES under an alternative normalizer (max-pdist or mean-pdist) -- then the median-pdist residual is a normalization-choice artifact -> restriction stands, disclosed honestly (H2 differs from the null mostly via dispersion; the apparent scale-invariant residual is normalizer-dependent).
decision_logic.escalate_for_interpretation: If the residual IS robust -- B=1000 confirms rejection (p<0.01, not floor) AND the obs-vs-null direction is CONSISTENT across >=2 of {median, max, mean}-pdist normalizers -- then there is a genuine scale-invariant H2 difference. STOP and escalate to Manager/User for the EXPAND-vs-RESTRICTION call: whether the difference is interpretable and ADDITIVE beyond the H0/H1 omnibus (human-judgment, informed by the stratification + embedding-dependence diagnostics + paper-claim-trace + topology-benchmark-review). This is NOT auto-expanded.

method_provenance.normalization: per-cloud distances / chosen scale; obs and each null normalized by own scale; scale-invariance enforced by the de-pended h2-dispersion-normalization-scale-invariance contract
method_provenance.reuses: trajectory_tda/scripts/run_h2_dispersion_dualmetric.py + the normalize_landmarks_by_median_pdist null-worker flag (T1.5d, commit c58155f); extend the normalizer to a parameter

expected_outcome: Either (a) the residual is normalizer-dependent -> restriction stands with disclosure, or (b) it is robust across power + normalizers -> escalate for the interpretation/additivity expand-vs-restriction judgment. No auto-expand; no manuscript H2 claim until the interpretation review concludes.
